NET-CASE-001.notes: Diagnosis is accurate and evidence directly matches the show run output. Approved fix.

NET-CASE-002.notes: Classic subinterface prerequisite oversight. Verified parent interface must be brought up.

NET-CASE-003.notes: Correct calculation of /25 boundary split. Verified.

NET-CASE-004.notes: Pool size expanded to /24. Clearing leases will allow laptop to acquire IP instantly.

NET-CASE-005.notes: AI identified wildcard mask error correctly, but also forgot that DNS (UDP 53) and HTTPS (TCP 443) may be needed. Added permit for port 443 and domain.

NET-CASE-006.notes: Clear evidence in debug logs and running-config. Verified Area 0 alignment.

NET-CASE-007.notes: Directly resolves the missing default route. Verified ISP next hop is reachable.

NET-CASE-008.notes: Verified. Inside interface was omitted during initial configuration.

NET-CASE-009.notes: Verified. Fixed DNS server parameter in DHCP pool.

NET-CASE-010.notes: Native VLAN must match on both ends of an 802.1Q trunk. Fix is 100% accurate.

NET-CASE-011.notes: Comprehensive RFC1918 isolation rule with essential DHCP/DNS permits.

NET-CASE-012.notes: Verified. Uplink to authorized DHCP server must have 'ip dhcp snooping trust'.

NET-CASE-013.notes: Spot-on diagnosis. Both routers were in Active state due to VIP mismatch.

NET-CASE-015.notes: Verified. Classic DHCP relay requirement across routed boundaries.

NET-CASE-017.notes: Always use 'add' keyword so existing allowed VLANs are not overwritten. Fix confirmed.

NET-CASE-018.notes: Verified. Appending permit for second subnet restores NAT translation.

NET-CASE-019.notes: Matches textbook duplex mismatch signature: late collisions on half-duplex side + CRC errors.

NET-CASE-020.notes: Standard ACLs should be placed close to destination, or use Extended ACL with specific destination IP.

NET-CASE-021.notes: Upgraded R2 to RIPv2 with auto-summary disabled for proper VLSM support.

NET-CASE-022.notes: Resetting the err-disabled state with sticky MAC configuration is standard practice.

NET-CASE-024.notes: AI diagnosis correct. Added recommendation to follow best practice: 'passive-interface default' with explicit 'no passive-interface' for routed uplinks.

NET-CASE-026.notes: Fix excludes router interface IP from pool. Alternatively 'ip nat inside source list 1 interface Gi0/1 overload' can be used.

NET-CASE-027.notes: Proper enterprise fix for static IPs under DAI using ARP ACL filter.

NET-CASE-028.notes: Standardizing MTU to 1500 allows DBD exchange to complete to FULL state.

NET-CASE-030.notes: Critical security risk resolved by binding Guest WLAN to dedicated isolated VLAN 90 interface.

NET-CASE-031.notes: Corrected summary mask from /22 to /21 (255.255.248.0) covering 10.20.0.0 - 10.20.7.255.

NET-CASE-032.notes: Verified. Helper address must point to unicast IP of remote DHCP server.
